subject: Culture
title: Clan Feuds Through History
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Clan Feuds Through History.

hook.text: The Hatfield-McCoy feud lasted 28 years and killed over a dozen people—all over a stolen pig.

buildup.text: Clan feuds erupt when insults to family honor go unavenged. Each retaliation demands a counter-strike.

discovery.text: Albanian blood feuds, called 'gjakmarrja,' followed strict rules: only adult males could be targeted.

twist.text: Some Albanian families kept boys locked indoors for decades to protect them from inherited vendettas.

climax.text: Feuds persist because apologizing signals weakness—and weakness invites fresh attacks.

punchline.text: Pride turns a single insult into generations of grief.

quiz.question: What is the Albanian term for blood feuds?

details.summary: Clan feuds — from the Hatfields and McCoys to Corsican vendetta to Albanian blood feuds — follow a predictable honor logic: an insult or injury demands retaliation, which provokes counter-retaliation, creating cycles of violence lasting generations.
details.whyItMatters: Clan feuds demonstrate how honor systems can trap communities in escalating violence. Understanding their logic is essential for peace-building in conflict zones worldwide.
takeaways: Albanian Kanun law codifies blood feuds with precise rules
The Hatfield-McCoy feud lasted from 1863 to 1891
Feuding cycles follow predictable escalation patterns across cultures

faq.question: Why do feuds last for generations?
faq.answer: Honor demands that every injury be avenged. Each act of revenge creates a new injury requiring further revenge. Collective honor means the entire clan is obligated to avenge any member's harm. Time does not diminish the obligation — honor debts persist until paid.

faq.question: What is the Albanian blood feud system?
faq.answer: The Kanun of Lekë Dukagjini (a 15th-century legal code) governs Albanian blood feuds with precise rules. A murdered man's family must kill a male member of the killer's family. Until revenge is taken, men from the targeted family are confined to their homes.
